assumptions.rtn: 4-bit packed codes, FP32 scale per group, no alignment/container headers
assumptions.nestquant: 4-bit fixed-width q=14 residues, 2-bit beta ID per E8 block, FP32 row norms, 4 FP32 beta values per linear layer, 32-bit q and 64-bit seed; no alignment/container headers

rtn_w4.assumptions: 4-bit packed signed codes; FP32 scale per group; ignores tensor padding and container headers

nestquant_w4_fixed_width.assumptions: q-ary residues fixed-width packed at 4 bits each; beta IDs fixed-width packed; FP32 row norms and per-layer beta tables; 32-bit q and 64-bit dither seed; ignores alignment and container headers
nestquant_w4_fixed_width.note: Entropy/arithmetic coding of q-ary residues could reduce code payload; no such coder exists in this project yet.
